review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The first idle, hit, defend and cast turned the plate dark in long stretches (the idle for 111 of 124 frames), so they are retaken as calm takes with one steady fog glow; the hit also keeps the fog close to the body instead of a translucent whip. The defend is retaken with room at the sides and holds the raised-anchor guard through 71, before the plate darkens. The attack is retaken with room above, since the anchor swing clipped the top of the frame. The walk loops one cycle over 59-117 and the death is used as generated.
